notes.title: 11/11/2014 Hotfix
notes.notes:
We’ve released a minor patch today that addresses some gameplay exploits that have come to light, as well as a few minor bug fixes we could sneak in. As this is a hotfix patch, rather than a full patch, it will be rolled out over the course of the next 24 hours to the various clients.

Fixed an exploit that allowed players to use 3rd party programs to allow them to play with decks which should have been illegal.

Fixed an exploit where a player would be stuck on the sideboarding screen infinitely if their opponent left the game through certain means.

Fixed a bug that would cause players to get a draw for a campaign game instead of a win or loss as proper.

Fixed a bug where the server wouldn’t log when a tutorial wasn’t being completed, getting some people that look at graphs very worried that we had the world’s hardest tutorial.

Thanks everyone! Keep your eyes out for some upcoming very important and very awesome communication.

notes.title: Massive Infinity Wars Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Massive Infinity Wars Update![/h1]

Patch 0.98 is live! The Patch Notes are so massive, that they actually exceed the Character Limit in these discussion boards. So in this post I'm going to give you some highlights, and link you to the full post on our official forums here:

http://forum.lightmare.com.au/index.php?topic=62088.0

[h1]Patch Highlights![/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Bugs Zapped![/b]
 
Today’s patch is a huge one, and we know you’ve all been waiting for it. We’ve given the game a nice facelift and we think you’ll agree that it looks much nicer. This patch addresses lots of card bugs, client bugs and adds some new shiny things in.

Lots and lots of new things to look at here.

[*][b]Shiny Things[/b]

-          New Login Screen. We decided to update the login screen to fit the theme of Infinity Wars more.
 
-          New Home Screen. Offers a new  way to show you special offers, community content, dev blogs and more!
 
-          New in-game UI. We have updated the in-game UI to make it more visually appealing and intuitive while playing.
 
-          The deckbuilder has been revamped. This includes:
o   Filters! Wonderful, fabulous filters. Name, purity, cost, artist, faction and more, they’re all there.
o   The ability to choose which faction multi purity commanders represent.
o   New way to view soulbound vs unsoulbound cards
 
-          New individual card effects, can you find them all?
 
-          New Warpath campaign is here! Help Aleta save the Untamed World.
 
-          New Exiles cardback for the fans of chaos out there.

[*]Terminology Changes

[*]Playing A Card

The way that abilities resolve has also had a bit of an optimization. As of this patch, when you activate an ability card in hand, it will now grey out in your hand instead of being sent directly to your graveyard. This allows us to keep more of the actual card movements to the resolution phase, which should help keep card complications down in the future.

[*]Standardizing Ability Triggers   

Abilities that trigger when a character comes into play now resolve in a more logical manner. Previously, come-into-play abilities that didn’t require a target would resolve when the character came into play, but come-into-play abilities that did require a target would not resolve until activated abilities and ability cards resolved.

[*]A huge amount of Client Bug fixes

[*]An even larger amount of Card Bug fixes

[*]Significant Balance Changes
[/list]

 We hope you continue to enjoy Infinity Wars, and help us spread the vision of the future of dTCG’s! Thanks again.
 
For any bug reports, please ensure you utilize the help menu with Submit a Bug, this is now the primary method of reporting all bugs and is monitored heavily.

For any account issues, please email support@lightmare.com.au with as much detail as possible.

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Version 0.97
notes.notes:
[h1]July 2nd 2014, Version 0.97.0[/h1]

Today's patch is a simple bug fixing, and minor additions patch. Many of the changes listed below were implemented in hot-fixes when possible, since the last patch.

Keep your eyes on an e-mail we'll be sending out tonight with a DevBlog from Teremus regarding the Balance of Infinity Wars. We're trying to increase communication and transparency, so make sure to keep your eyes peeled on the e-mails attached to your accounts!

[h1]Change Log[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a ‘Add Friend’ button to chat boxes. 
[*]Fixed a bug where when opening a card pack, the first card would display incorrectly. 
[*]Fix purity tooltip to correct Overseers faction name. 
[*]Fixed bug that caused the names of items in the store to overlap. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players to need to click 'Normal Play' twice to start a game. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Nature's Sanctuary battlefield to cause clipping issues with UI. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused chat boxes to appear behind Global chat on the Match Result screen. 
[*]Fixed some spelling errors in the campaigns. 
[*]Demonize: Now correctly removes other sub-types when making you a Demon. 
[*]Eagle-Eye: Is now correctly affected by power buffs. 
[*]Humble: Now should work better with persistent effects like Pack Leader. 
[*]Engine of Reincarnation: No longer removes anything from the grave when creating tokens. 
[*]Kali(s): Should no longer immolate herself when she gets poisoned. 
[*]Suffering Verorian: Now actually turns into a Demon when deployed through exile. 
[*]Blood Arrow: Can now target your own characters. 
[*]Infect: The mouse over tooltip no longer references slow. 
[*]Agent Coyle, Soulseller: Now creates a 20/20 Dragon with Flying and Unstoppable. 
[*]Descension: Can now be played through exile with 6 base resources and a resource increasing effect such as Wealthy Noble. Also correctly creates a 20/20 Dragon with flying, unstoppable and consume 3. 
[*]Solace's Gate: Now removes untouchable correctly from characters when it is destroyed. 
[*]Gather Thoughts: Now correctly takes form the top, not the bottom of the Graveyard. 
[*]Sydern: Fixed so that now giving an opponent Sydern will properly stop their resources increase. 
[*]Tygrugh, the Insane: Now correctly increases his cost from your Hand, not your opponents. 
[*]Azael: No longer gives herself untouchable. 
[*]Hilderick: Now costs 15.
[/list] 

A lot of things are happening behind the scenes and we're very excited to bring you information in the near future, so stay tuned.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Version 0.96.5 and Ascension Launch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.96.5 Patch Notes[/h1]

[i]It’s time to fly![/i]

Today’s patch focuses on Ascension. With the set releasing in 2 days’ time, this patch is dedicated to the cards. There are balance changes, and some important bug fixes.

[u]Note: Ascension cards will NOT be tournament legal until Wednesday, June 18th 12am IWT.[/u]

[h1]Ascension[/h1]

It’s almost here! This patch added in all of the Ascension cards [although you won't be able to open your preorder packs until the 14th still], and also added in the Overseers Campaign, which is ready and waiting for you to play.

For more information around Ascension preorders, please [url=http://forum.lightmare.com.au/index.php?topic=32757.0]click here[/url].

[h1]Card Changes[/h1]
[list]

[*]Xi, Who Honors the Dead
The tokens created by Xi, Who Honors the Dead are now removed from the game upon death.

[*]Kali, The Purifier 
Kali is now a 10/8 for a cost of 3. Kali, The Purifier is now double purity.

[*]This change was made because we wanted Ascended Kali to have a higher power than initially drafted. In order to keep the cycle of Kali, we had to strengthen Kali, The Purifier.

[*]Gowron
Gowron can now only create characters while on the Battlefield.

[*]Apparition
Apparition can now only target characters on the Battlefield.

[*]Master of Demons
Master of Demons is now a 1/1 that gains +3/+3 for each demon on the Battlefield when she is played.

[*]Summoner of the Deep
Summoner of the Deep’s ability now costs 2 but can be activated multiple times per turn.

[*]Flame Dawn Commando
Flame Dawn Commando now deals 4 damage to a character on the Battlefield when he is played.

[*]Demonborn
Demonborn no longer has flying, but has an activated ability for 4 that grants flying for a turn.

[*]Gather Thoughts
Gather Thoughts now costs 1, but only returns the top 3 cards to your deck.

[*]Overclock
Overclock’s cost is reduced to 4.

[*]Swift Strikes
Swift Strikes now grants an additional attack, instead of making it always 2 attacks.

[*]Drag Down
Drag Down’s effect is now permanent.

[*]Altar of Binding
Altar of Binding now binds the target character to its current zone, and has its cost reduced to 3.

[*]Bromich’s Banner
Bromich’s Banner now costs 4
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]

[*]Increased unstoppable limit (max number of attacks per turn) to 50.

[*]Game Invites now correctly show the Game Format of the game invitation. 

[*]Fixed a cause of endless turn bug, where if either player disconnected before either player had ended turn, the game was unable to reconnect.

[*]Fixed a desync issue where if a player ended turn while disconnected, their opponent would have effectively have their turn skipped.

[*]Fixed a desync issue where abilities would fail in the turn after a player had reconnected. 

[*]Maximum number of reconnection attempts increased to 10, and now resets count for each disconnect.

[*]Fixed a bug where a player would be missing cards after rejoining game.
 
[*]If a player is AFK for 3 turns, they will receive a defeat for the game. This fixes a bug where players that went AFK could rejoin a game which had already been completed. 

[*]Fixed IP bonuses when a player you invited purchases LP.
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy Infinity Wars, and help us spread the vision of the future of dTCG’s! Thanks again.

For any bug reports, please ensure you utilize the help menu with Submit a Bug, this is now the primary method of reporting all bugs and is monitored heavily.

For any account issues, please email support@lightmare.com.au with as much detail as possible.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Version 0.96
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Patch Notes for Version 0.96[/h1][/b]
It’s patch time! Today’s patch focuses on polishing Infinity Wars, and major bug-fixing. For our players, we have a sexy new campaign screen, new purchasable battlefields, a much more robust system of reconnecting to an interrupted connection, the removal of Slow as a keyword, and lots of small bug fixes.

[h1]New Campaign Screen[/h1]
After reviewing our current campaign experience, we’ve decided to go through them and revamp the experience. From now on, we’ll be releasing continual updates to the campaign, rolling out a new faction’s campaign on a regular basis. The new campaigns have been designed to be much more interesting, both in gameplay and story. With this patch, we’re also releasing a completely new campaign screen. Mere patch notes can’t describe how it looks, play the game to see!

[h1]New Purchasable Battlefields[/h1]
One of the most interesting items players can buy at the in-game store are default battlefield replacements, but historically the only options for players were two battlefields that didn’t particularly have any sort of theme that interested players. At Lightmare Studios we’re always looking for ways to support ourselves as a company with items that don’t affect gameplay, and reduce our dependance on card sales. With this in mind, we’ve created a new purchasable battlefield for each faction, so you can represent your favourite faction.

[h1]No More Slow[/h1]
While reviewing the gameplay of Infinity Wars, we decided that ‘Slow’ was both unitunitive and un-fun to play with. While it was originally designed to provide a zombie-like drawback to balance out many Sleeper cards, instead we’ve found that it merely makes the cards worse than players evaluate a card to be, and confuses players when its effect happens. We’ve removed Slow from the game entirely, and balanced around its removal instead. We will be watching closely the balance of Infect cards, a while we expect a short resurgence of Sleeper decks from players, we think it will still be balanced. If any cards do turn out to be too overpowered without Slow holding it back, we’ll be ready to jump in and set things right.

[h1]The Death of Endless Turn (?)[/h1]
The dreaded ‘endless turn’ bug has been one that has been souring player experience for quite a while, and we’ve been dedicating a lot of resources to making sure it’s been defeated. The endless turn bug is caused by losing connection to the game hosting servers, however momentarily. We’ve created a system where players will now reconnect automatically if they lose connection, and hopefully games will now go much more smoothly, and the era of the Endless Turn bug will recede into myth, a dark time beta testers speak of in hushed tones. (Update: it seems the bug is down, but refuses to die. Any bug reports you send us if you get the error will help us greatly. Thank you for your help.)

For a full list of patch notes and the change log, please view the forum post [url=http://forum.lightmare.com.au/index.php?topic=29551.0]here.[/url]

For any bug reports, please ensure you utilize the help menu with Submit A Bug.
For any account issues, please e-mail support@lightmare.com.au with as much detail as possible.

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Version 0.95.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes for Build 0.95.6[/h1]

Today’s patch includes everything needed for the launch of our Star Trek set, and with it comes a few changes to allow Infinity Wars to have cards from an exterior brand:

We’ve updated how queuing for Normal games works now. When queuing for a normal game, you can choose different deck formats to queue up for, and most importantly you can queue for multiple types at once. To accommodate Star Trek (and other possible non-core Infinity Wars sets), the game types you can queue for are:
Infinity format: in this format, any card in the game is allowed (including sets like Omni and Star Trek)

Core format: Only ‘Core’ Infinity Wars cards are allowed. Core sets are sets such as IW2013, Rise, Infestation and Ascension.

Ranked format: Allows players to search for games that would only be legal in Ranked. This allows players to practice their ranked decks against players that are also looking for practice. Only Core sets currently on sale are allowed in ranked format (currently IW2013, Rise and Infestation). Actual Ranked games are, naturally, always in Ranked format.

Merged format: Any card in the game is allowed, both decks will be shuffled together at the start of the game.

Due to certain restrictions happening in this patch, Pauper was not able to be added to the new format queue screen properly. In the next patch, Pauper will be in this menu for open playability. Don't worry, we know how much it's loved.

With the introduction of this new queueing system, players should be better able to find a matching game, and more encouraged to play less popular modes such as Merged, without being stuck in a queue forever. For the time being, Hyper and Epic are not available, but we plan to reintroduce them, and other fun modes, in a regular rotating format so that players constantly have the option of trying out a new, fun mode without creating huge queue times for those players.

We’ve also updated the look of the cards, particularly down at the bottom of the card. For a long time, it’s been on our hit-list to update the bottom of the cards graphically. Where there was previously flat grey, now there is a proper texture for each faction. We also felt that there was too much text that was rarely game relevant, in-game it’s not needed to see the word ‘common’ or the set name, or set number. We also needed a way to clearly distinguish Core Infinity Wars cards from other cards, now Core cards are labelled ‘Infinity Wars’ while non Core sets have their own branding clearly visible (a contractual obligation, in the case of Star Trek).

We hope that you enjoy playing with the new Star Trek cards, it’s been a fun set to produce and we look forward to more fun, casual sets like it in the future. If you’re not a Star Trek fan, don’t worry, Ascension is coming in the near future!

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to ignore player’s requests for a game or trading.
[*]The game will now always ask for a deck when being invited to a game, rather than simply using the previous deck (which is often not intended by the player)
[*]Aleta the Immortal Traveler can now create Sleeper of Avarrachs
[*]Demonize now correctly changes card subtype to demon.
[*]Ancient Egg has been made more standardized
[*]Updated matchmaking in Rift Runs so that players with 10 or more wins will be matched against each other much more often.
[*]It is now possible to queue for multiple types of queues at the same time when looking for a normal game.
[*]Infected Drone should now transform when targeted by an ability with multiple targets (most notably Secluded Constructor and Fight!)
[*]Fixed the cause of a bug that would cause the Academy quest line to become stuck at 12/15.
[*]Changed the card borders to reduce the clutter of text that was not game-relevant.
[*]Changed the order and levels that features are unlocked for new players:
[*]The deckbuilder is always available, with a message explaining how to get new cards for players with small collections.
[*]Merged Deck (Constructed) is available at level 3.
[*]Practice Draft is available at level 4.
[*]Infinite (Constructed) and normal Draft are available at level 5.
[*]Trade is available at level 6.
[*]All other constructed modes are available at level 7.
[*]Ranked is not available until level 10.
[*]Inviting a player is available at any level.
[/list]

We couldn't continue doing this and fixing so many issues without the help and support of our amazing players. You guys deserve so much thanks and credit, you've helped us in our beta an incredible amount and from all of us at Lightmare Studios, thank you.

One of the largest problems going on right now is the issues surrounding Rift Runs. We're in the process of actually upgrading the hardware, and the server itself to completely eradicate these issues. It's been a long and arduous process but one that will eventually fix a lot of problems Infinity Wars has been facing since the days of Alpha.

We hope you continue to enjoy Infinity Wars, and help us spread the vision of the future of dTCG's! Thanks again.

[u]For any bug reports, please ensure you utilize the help menu with Submit A Bug, this is now the primary method of reporting all bugs and is monitored heavily.

For any account issues, please e-mail Support@lightmare.com.au with as much detail as possible. [/u]

notes.title: Patch 0.95 Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
Today's patch marks the release of quite a few major features: quests, medals, titles, a new profile screen, a new loading screen, and a new chat interface! Let's go over the changes!

Throughout Infinity Wars' history, we've seen players have a lot of confusion about how to get new exciting things for free. New players get lost, not knowing where to go next. Furthermore, long time players have no end-game goals to shoot for, and no way to show off their accomplishments to other players. The new quest system is our answer to these problems. As you play Infinity Wars, you'll complete various quests, giving you better and better rewards.

Many quests award Medals, which are used to show off your accomplishments in Infinity Wars. When you play against another player, our new (and much more optimized) loading screen will show off your medals.

Another reward you can earn through quests is Titles. Once earned, Titles can be displayed to other players. Ever wanted to be known as Champion Puffy? Well now you can! (Or rather, you could be if your username was Puffy, which it isn't. Also, Puffy's win/loss ratio is terrible.)

All these new additions can be found on the Profile screen, which has been completely redone.

This Quest system replaces our previous Faction Levels system, and all rewards from the Faction Levels system have been moved into the Quest system.

Last, but not least, we have an entirely new chat interface. It is now much better laid out, especially for talking to friends, and is persistent across all aspects of the game, making it much easier to talk to friends.


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
We've introduced adjustments to a few cards released in Infestation, which will we explain here:

[i]Infected Drone now transforms into a 7/7 (previously a 8/8).[/i]
When Infected Drone transforms, it becomes one the most efficient character in the game, a 8/8 for 2 (in addition to being Artificial, generally a benefit in Genesis). In Genesis, transforming the Drone is a fairly trivial task, and allowed Genesis to have early game aggression far beyond its curve, so we've turned it down a bit.

[i]Aether Acolyte is now a 5/5 that increases by 1/1 when an ability is played. (Previously a 3/3 that increased by 2/2).[/i]
While in a vacuum Aether Acolyte's power level isn't overpowered (although it's a very powerful card), in the context of Verore it becomes simply too strong. Normally, Verore doesn't have efficient, fast beaters, and this is an important weakness of the faction. We've decided to bring up Aether Acolyte's base stats a little bit, but severely decrease how quickly she can get large.

[i]Uncontrolled Rift now costs 2 (previously 1).[/i]
Uncontrolled Rift is arguably one of the reasons Aether Acolyte was so strong. However, we feel that Uncontrolled Rift is in too strong a place right now, and can be used with many other cards to overpowering effect, Aether Acolyte was merely the best option at the time. We never intended Uncontrolled Rift to be so furiously competitive, it's a card that while fun, introduces a level of dumb 
luck that we don't want to push too hard, and are going to bring it down a bit.

[i]Flame Dawn Fanatic now has 8 power, up from 6.[/i]
Not everything has to be nerfs! We felt that Flame Dawn Fanatic's stats were simply too low to be sexy as a three purity card, so we're making him stronger.

[i]Ritual Master is now a 0/4, and his ability doesn't buff himself.[/i]
Ritual Master, if left unchecked, is a very strong card. However, in its previous incarnation he left very little room for any player to deal with him, and we wanted decks to be able to answer a Ritual Master.

[i]Death Ray and Perils of Command have been moved to Uncommon (previously common).[/i]
Drafting Verore has been extremely strong, since its commons offer some of the best removal in the game. We decided to bring this back a bit, so that you can't guarantee yourself a full playset of premium removal when you draft Verore.

[i]Bloodthirst health bonus has been reworked.[/i]
The health bonus from Bloodthirst has been reworked so that it acts as a buffer against damage, as in its previous incarnation, a Bloodthirsted character would usually simply die at the end of the turn.


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Various fixes for various causes of the 'endless turn' glitch.
[*]Swarmer characters should now get Consume functioning correctly.
[*]Fixed a bug with Swarmers' display text being incorrect from increases/losses from Brutal Swarmer.
[*]Swarmers now correctly longer apply in command zone.
[*]Cyber Infested Dragon no longer leaves play if it dies in command (formerly token spawning wasn't occurring (correctly) although it was still getting removed from play (incorrectly)).
[*]Dead Feaster will now correctly keep stats when dead.
[*]Hubris of the Strong now flushes damage dealt, so it doesn't kill cards that have previously taken damage.
[*]Splatterer, Devil of Despair, Ritual Master and Frenzied Monstrosity's discard now properly resolve in the resolution phase instead of the planning phase.
[*]Infected Purifier should correctly become undead on transformation.
[*]Agent Coyle, Zomborg's splash ability correctly hits battlefield now, instead of all cards in play.
[*]Agent Coyle, Zomborg's ability can no longer be used when the player has insufficient resources.
[*]Immortal Traveller can now create Survival Swarmers.
[*]Preemptive should resolve correctly on several cards in Infestation where it did not.
[*]Chalice of Madness now correctly discards a card prior to drawing for the turn.
[*]Xi, who honors the dead should correctly check for valid targets.
[*]Shield generator allows cards to be played the turn its owner chooses to sacrifice it.
[*]Fight can longer target it's controller's cards for it's second target (as per card text)
[*]Card abilities that trigger when entering the battlefield should no longer proc a second time if their zone changes from out of play.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.95 Preview Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]This is a preview of the notes for build 0.95, scheduled for release March 12th, 2014.[/h1]

Infinity Wars is dedicated to improving the quality, stability, and playability of the game. While we are yet in an early beta with a lot of work ahead of us, our players and community have been invaluable in shaping the evolution of Digital TCG's alongside myself and our amazing tiny group of talented developers and passionate staff.

Without you, none of this would exist. So join Lightmare Studios in celebrating each and every step we take moving forward as we move ever closer to finishing the game with each patch and each hotfix we put into the game.

It will take time, it will take dedication, but above all else it will take the patience and eagerness to see the game improve that we know all of you grant us. Thank you for being a part of our Beta.

[b][u]The following features and fixes are scheduled to be applied to the live server in this build. [/b][/u]

A much improved chat interface which is much more optimized and easier to use. The new chat interface is ubiquitous to every part of the game, so players can now chat as easily in game as out of it.

A whole new Quest system. The new Quest system gives players rewards based on accomplishing various quests in the game, giving them immediate and long term goals.

Titles. Players can now earn titles through the new Quest system, which they can then show off to other players.

Medals. Various quests now award medals to players, which are shown off to other players to show off their accomplishments.

A new profile screen. The new profile screen follows the new design that we are redoing all the old menus with. It contains all your quest progress and shows you which quests you have to complete still. It also shows all the medals you have acquired.

A new loading screen. The new loading screen shows the name, title and avatars of both you and your opponent and also shows any medals.

[b]Card Alterations[/b]

For the next patch, we're looking at a couple of cards in Infestation whose power level is not quite where we'd like them to be. The following cards are currently under review:

Aether Acolyte: We feel that this card's power level is too high, and allows for plays that are far too aggressive for Verore, which should be one of the slowest factions. We are looking at retuning the numbers so that it fills the role of a built-up late game finisher, rather than a hyper-aggressive card.

Ritual Master: While we like this card's design, it is currently so strong that it warps the entire Exiles faction to being about this card. Furthermore, its ability to constantly give itself health quickly takes it out of range to be dealt with, giving very little counter-play to the card. Ritual Master will no longer buff himself.

Uncontrolled Rift: This card is mostly seen in combination with Aether Acolyte and Verore Magic Siphoner, and is much more highly competitive card than was ever intended. Even with the weakening of Aether Acolyte, we are looking at raising the cost of Uncontrolled Rift, lest it merely find its way into overpowering more decks.

Flame Dawn Fanatic: We currently feel this card is very underwhelming for a 3 purity card, with stats that are simply too low to be appealing.

Demoralize: We are looking at tweaking this card to deal slightly more morale damage, as currently 8 morale damage is too low to close out game that's been brought down to very low morale.

Infested Drone: Triggering Infested Drone's ability, especially for Genesis, has proven to be so easy that the card feels straight up more efficient than Knight of the Flame Dawn, which is not something we want in the Genesis faction. We'll be looking at minor tweaks to the numbers of this card.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Zomborg doesn't evolve in graveyard
- Immortal Traveller can create Survival Swarmers
- Preemptive should resolve correctly on several cards
- Bloodthirst reworked to work like a buffer, where the damage will come off the bloodthirst health first.
- Chalice of Madness correctly discards a card prior to drawing for the turn
- Splatterer, Devil of Despair, Ritual Master and Frenzied Monstrosity's discards resolve in the resolution phase.
- Infected Purifier should correctly become undead on transformation
- Zomborg's splash ability correctly hits battlefield now, instead of in play
- Zomborg's ability can no longer be used when the player has insufficient resources 
- Swarmers should have consume functioning correctly
- Swarmers' display text shouldn't bug out anymore for increases/losses from Brutal Swarmer
- Swarmers effects no longer apply in command zone
- Cyber Infested Dragon no longer leaves play if it dies in command (formerly token spawning wasn't occuring (correctly) although it was still getting removed from play (incorrectly))
- Dead Feaster keeps stats when dead
- Hubris of the Strong flushes damage dealt, so it doesn't kill cards that have previously taken damage.
- Kyrallic no longer allows the sacrifices of secluded constructor to return.
- Leaving a game in progress by quitting the client will now concede the game.
- Infestation is now properly allowed for ranked in Mac clients.

[b]General Notes[/b]

- There is currently a rather common glitch known as the Endless Turn. There is no way to anticipate this occurring, there is no way to prevent this from occurring, there is no way to fix the problem once it has occurred.

We are very much so dedicated to breaking this bug, it is one of our highest priorities right now, but we need your help to do so.

When you are in a match and the game does not progress when the timer hits 00:00 you are affected by this glitch. The very second you see this happen DO NOT restart your client, but do the following:

(For Steam Users)
Right click IW in your library on steam, hit properties - local files - browse local files - open Infinity Wars_TCG Data

(For Windows Users)
Right click the desktop icon for IW, hit properties, open file location, locate Infinity Wars_TCG Data 

(For Mac Users)
Open up the Finder and search for Infinity Wars. Open that up and locate Updater.log (And replace the below instructions for an output log with the updater.log).

Make a copy of Output_Log.txt and attach it in an e-mail to Marketing@lightmare.com.au with a brief description of the problem.

If you are in a Rift Run and you lose a match due to this glitch and would like a refund of your IP, simply e-mail Support@lightmare.com.au with a statement regarding this and a request of a refund for this glitch. Be aware we ARE going to check your game log to ensure that no one is simply requesting IP without being affected by the glitch.

- Another, less common glitch, is the Combat Freeze. Where two cards go into combat and the game hangs on that animation and the cards don't leave the center of your screen. Please follow the above instructions to get me an output/updater log with a description of the scenario so that we can use that information to break the glitch.

- The Purity problem with Hybrid Commanders in Rift Runs still exist. Please do not select a Hybrid card as a commander when drafting your deck in Rift Runs to avoid complications until it is fixed.

We appreciate everyones assistance in helping us test and fix problems that are of this scale, it's plaguing a lot of users and we're doing all we can to break it.

Thank you everyone! See you on the battlefield.

notes.title: 0.94.05 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
It's no secret that since our release on Steam, Infinity Wars has been booming! We want to thank all our fans which have been with us, and all our new fans for making Infinity Wars a success! 

Today's patch contains less fixes than normal, simply because over the last week we've been patching many fixes directly to Live as we find issues with the huge influx of new players, which required fixes to go out immediately. This patch contains all the data for Infestation, which will be going live 12:01 Saturday 22nd (IWT). Don't forget to get your preorders in before then, it will be the last chance to get get Platinum-bordered Infestation cards!

Included in Infestation is a major rework for the Exiles faction, which includes reworks to existing Exile cards. With these changes, we expect the Exiles to become a much more viable and fun faction, and look forward to feedback.

Change Log:

Fixed an issue that caused campaign progress not to be saved after playing a PvP game.

Fixed an issue with restarting a single player mission.

Issues that are still under investigation:

There are still issues with being able to purchase LP on both clients. Please follow this link to resolve this problem:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/257730/discussions/0/540733523920582677/

There are still issues with some players experiencing the problems of being unable to connect when trying to log in. If this is affecting you please do the following WITHOUT closing your client beforehand. Make sure it stays open.

Right click IW in your library on steam, hit properties - local files - browse local files - open Infinity Wars_TCG Data

Make a copy of Output_Log.txt and attach it in an e-mail to Marketing@lightmare.com.au with a statement of what error message you saw.

Rift Run selection screens freezing and being generally slow. Just re-log until you see it working, it saves your progress.

Randomly seeing 0 XP/IP gains for matches. Be assured that you do gain the points but they're being credited to your account when you play a match later on, which is the glitch.

Thanks for being a part of the beta everyone, we'll continue working our hardest to expel the bugs, optimize the server connections, and improve the overall quality of our Beta. See you on the battlefield everyone! ~Teremus
